directives.raw: keep Python; Flask -> FastAPI; SQLite -> PostgreSQL; add pytest + CI; no frontend needed

items.reason: source models no frontend (A-1, A-5); there is nothing to modernize

infrastructure.target: Docker + uvicorn workers + GitHub Actions CI

decisions.summary: Replace Flask with FastAPI: async endpoints, Pydantic v2 request/response models, auto OpenAPI
decisions.from: Flask 3.0.0, manual request.get_json + jsonify, synchronous handlers
decisions.to: FastAPI 0.115 + Pydantic v2 models; declarative 422 responses; OpenAPI at /docs
decisions.why: user directive D-2; built-in validation removes the raw-500 error class and async fits the I/O-bound handlers

decisions.summary: Move the ORM layer to SQLAlchemy 2.0 typed mapping with an async session and Alembic-managed migrations
decisions.from: Flask-SQLAlchemy 3.1.1 with a single hand-written SQL file and no migration tooling
decisions.to: SQLAlchemy 2.x async + Alembic; existing schema re-issued as an Alembic baseline
decisions.why: user directive D-3; typed mapping removes string-based queries and Alembic closes the unversioned-schema gap (A-3)

decisions.summary: Swap the SQLite file database for PostgreSQL 16
decisions.to: PostgreSQL 16, asyncpg driver, DATABASE_URL from environment
decisions.why: user directive D-3; PostgreSQL is the target for any multi-process deployment behind uvicorn workers

decisions.summary: Introduce typed request/response schemas so invalid input yields 422 with field errors instead of 500
decisions.from: manual get_json + dict access; KeyError on missing keys surfaces as HTTP 500
decisions.to: Pydantic v2 NoteCreate/NoteRead schemas; HTTPException(400) for empty title; 422 from framework validation
decisions.why: closes I-2 and A-4 with the standard modern idiom that ships with the M-1 framework

decisions.summary: Add a pytest + httpx AsyncClient test suite and a GitHub Actions CI workflow with a coverage gate
decisions.from: no test suite in repo, no pytest dependency
decisions.to: pytest 8.x + httpx + pytest-cov (80% line-coverage gate) + .github/workflows/ci.yml running on every push
decisions.why: user directive D-4; closes A-2 and makes the M-1/M-4 behavior changes verifiable

decisions.summary: Replace the debug dev-server entrypoint with uvicorn workers in a Docker image; debug never enabled in production
decisions.to: uvicorn[standard] with gunicorn workers in a Dockerfile; environment-driven config; no debug flag
decisions.why: closes I-1; debug=True is unsafe outside localhost and the app needs a real serving path to run the M-3/M-5 stack

kept.element: User/Note entities with 1:N ownership and the two-table schema shape
email+password login semantics (credential check, session row, token in response)

assumptions.quote: Frontend: none in repo (UNVERIFIED - no template/SPA sources)
assumptions.reason: user directive D-5 confirms no frontend; the system stays backend-only by decision

assumptions.quote: no test suite in repo - UNVERIFIED (no tests/, no pytest dep in requirements)
assumptions.resolution: Testing Strategy rewritten around pytest + httpx AsyncClient with a CI coverage gate (M-5)

assumptions.quote: schema comes from a single hand-written SQL file with no tooling (UNVERIFIED - no Alembic/Flyway config)
assumptions.resolution: Alembic adopted; 0001_init.sql re-issued as the Alembic baseline revision (M-2)

assumptions.quote: behavior for a malformed JSON body is UNVERIFIED (no explicit handling seen)
assumptions.resolution: Pydantic v2 request models define the behavior: 422 with field-level errors (M-4)

assumptions.quote: No frontend classes - no UI in repo (UNVERIFIED by absence search)
assumptions.reason: consistent with D-5; the modernized class model intentionally has no frontend section content beyond DTOs

assumptions.quote: request handling is synchronous, single-process Flask (UNVERIFIED - no async/queue code found)
assumptions.reason: deep concurrency modeling is out of scope; M-6 documents the uvicorn worker model and M-1 makes handlers async, which removes the single-process bottleneck

issues.quote: debug=True in the entrypoint is an anti-pattern for any non-local deployment
issues.resolution: production entrypoint via uvicorn workers; debug disabled by construction (M-6)

issues.quote: unhandled KeyError -> 500 on POST /api/notes for a missing title key
issues.resolution: Pydantic request models turn the 500 into a 422 with field errors (M-4)
